full_prompt_en: A square monochrome coloring sheet shows a woodland floor where one enormous mushroom dominates the right foreground. Its broad domed cap rises across the middle of the image, with a clean curved contour and fine scattered spots. Under the cap, closely spaced gill lines radiate toward a thick pale stem that descends beyond the bottom edge. Smaller mushrooms cluster at the left and along the midground, their cap rims and short stalks partly hidden by stones. The lower field is packed with rounded rocks, broken twigs, tufts of grass, and granular soil markings. Several tall trunks climb vertically behind the fungi, with irregular bark textures, small branches, and leafy or needle-like foliage. In the distance, a few sharply rectilinear building forms appear between the trunks, including a ribbed high facade on the right and stepped boxes on the left. Those remote planes stay lighter and less densely inked than the objects in front. The scene is drawn entirely in black, gray, and open white paper. Strong contour lines define the mushroom cap, gills, stalk, tree edges, and stones; fine hatching, stippling, and short repeated marks supply local volume and texture. There is no filled-in color, wash, or shading gradient beyond line density. White spaces inside major shapes are deliberately broad enough to accept coloring, while the ground and bark give more intricate small areas. The view is low, near the level of the smaller fungi, making the main cap feel unusually large. No human figure or readable caption appears. The result combines a detailed natural-history line drawing with a curious glimpse of modern geometry in the background, all held in crisp printable outlines.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色涂色线稿呈现林地地面，一株巨大的蘑菇占据右侧前景。宽阔的圆顶菌盖横跨画面中部，轮廓弯曲干净，上面散有细小斑点。菌盖下面，密集的菌褶线向粗壮浅色菌柄放射，菌柄延伸出画面底边。较小蘑菇成群分布在左侧与中景，菌盖边缘和短柄部分被石块遮住。下方密布圆石、断枝、草丛和颗粒状土壤记号。数根高树干从菌群后面竖直上升，具有不规则树皮纹、小枝以及叶状或针状树冠。远处几处棱角分明的建筑形体从树干之间显露：右边有带细密竖线的高立面，左边是层层退台的方块。这些远处平面比前景物件更浅、线迹更疏。全景只用黑、灰和纸面留白绘成。强轮廓线界定菌盖、菌褶、菌柄、树缘与石块；细排线、点描和短促重复笔迹赋予局部体积与肌理。没有填入的颜色、色洗，也没有线密度之外的渐变。大形体内部特意留下足以涂色的宽白区，地面与树皮则提供更繁密的小区域。视点很低，接近小菌高度，使主菌盖显得异常巨大。没有人物或可读标题。画面把精细的自然观察线描和远景中奇异的现代几何结合在清晰可印刷的轮廓中。
style_prompt_en: Crisp black linework on open white paper establishes a printable coloring-sheet surface. Firm outer contours organize the main silhouettes, while thinner parallel strokes, stippling, short crosshatches, and repeated texture marks supply volume without filling the shapes. Large quiet white interiors alternate with intricate clusters of tiny marks, giving both easy colorable areas and passages for close attention. Foreground forms carry stronger ink weight and denser detail; distant rectilinear planes are lighter, simpler, and partly screened by organic verticals. A low viewpoint magnifies a central curved mass and allows small elements to overlap densely across the lower edge. There is no color fill or tonal wash; depth comes from line weight, spacing, occlusion, and changes in detail. The overall impression is meticulous, illustrative, and slightly whimsical, with natural curves set beside restrained geometric forms.
style_prompt_zh: 清脆黑线落在大片白纸上，形成可印刷的涂色页表面。坚实外轮廓组织主要剪影，较细的平行笔迹、点描、短交叉排线和重复纹理则在不填满形状的情况下表现体积。宽阔安静的白色内部与繁密细小笔痕群交替，既有便于上色的大区，也有适合细看的段落。前景形体墨色更重、细节更密；远方直线平面较浅较简，并被有机竖向线条部分遮挡。低视点放大中央弧形主体，让细小元素在下缘密集重叠。没有彩色填充或调子色洗；深度来自线宽、间距、遮挡和细节变化。整体精密、插画化而略带奇趣，天然曲线与克制的几何形状并置。
theme_en: A giant mushroom among smaller fungi, stones, trees, and geometric buildings as a black ink coloring sheet
theme_zh: 黑墨线稿涂色页中，巨蘑菇立于小菌、石块、树木与几何建筑之间
name: Coloring-in sheet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
